description: AI‑first, zero‑dependency Node.js framework that outpaces Express & Fastify with type‑safe routing, instant edge deployment, and built‑in zero‑trust security.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the 2026 surge in AI‑native and edge‑compute workloads by positioning yantravese as the only zero‑dependency framework that bundles AI routing, built‑in observability, and instant deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Bun/Deno. Emphasize measurable speed gains (up to 3× faster than Fastify) and out‑of‑the‑box security (zero‑trust, JWT, CSP) to dominate searches for “express alternative”, “fast routing”, and “edge framework”.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates every external dependency while delivering Express‑compatible APIs with AI‑driven routing out of the box.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency than Fastify on edge runtimes, thanks to a compiled‑to‑WebAssembly core and native edge‑runtime bindings.

The developer experience is streamlined: TypeScript‑first APIs, automatic OpenAPI docs, one‑click deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Bun, or Deno, and built‑in observability with OpenTelemetry.
